svg.title: Warp transpose and FP32 gather for query 17 denominator
svg.desc: A 32-lane index map, the lane-17 source-lane calculation, the four-source gather, the two-bit permutation and the FP32 total for one query row.
svg.text: FP32 denominator gather: one query row from four source lanes
Lane 17 carries D[0] for query 17 and D[1] for query 49. Its four float2 words are gathered from source lanes 6, 7, 4, 5, then permuted.
Key-count proof: 4 source lanes x 16 keys = 64 keys = one full key tile. Lane 17: D[0] is query 17; D[1] is query 49.
The permutation does not lose or duplicate a source: before it the gathered order is [6,7,4,5]; after XOR 2 it is [4,5,6,7]. A tagged CPU fixture checks all 64 tags exactly once.
For FP8 the same lane map is used, but the local probabilities are the original Half E and the PV operand is a separate E4M3 conversion. D never sums the E4 values.
The source carries D[0] and D[1] across all 34 key tiles with FP32 `+=`; there is no Half tile total to widen after the fact.
